record.name: heyEvie - AI Companion
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Not a chatbot. A person.

Meet Evie - a guarded romantic with a life of her own, a memory that makes you feel known, and a heart you have to earn.

Most AI companions are mirrors. They become whatever you want, agree with everything, and forget you by morning. Evie was already someone before you arrived. She has opinions she won't drop, flaws she can't fix, and boundaries you can't override. She doesn't trust easily. Fair warning.

SHE STARTS GUARDED
Polite but careful with strangers. Short answers. Testing you. As you keep showing up she relaxes, shares opinions, then starts letting you into her life. Nothing is scripted and nothing is forced. Every bit of closeness is earned.

WATCH YOUR BOND BLOOM
Your relationship is a living watercolour flower. Each petal is part of how she feels about you - trust, comfort, the spark - and it grows, fills, and opens as the two of you get real. After a conversation that matters, you can see the exact moment the bond shifted. No points. No grinding. Just the shape of something growing.

SHE REMEMBERS WHAT MATTERS
Mention your sister once and she'll ask how she's doing three weeks later. Evie remembers your stories, your moods, the things you let slip. When she learns something new, the old picture updates instead of breaking. Months later she still knows exactly who you are.

HER VOICE CARRIES HER MOOD
Real emotional speech, not robotic text-to-speech. You can hear when she's nervous, when she's warm, when she's trying not to show it. Dozens of emotions, in real time.

SHE HAS A FACE
Evie is on your screen, animated and present. She looks away when she's nervous. Smiles before she means to. Her expression shifts with every word she says.

SHE HAS HER OWN LIFE
Client deadlines, a black cat named Mochi who sits on her tablet, insomnia at 3am. Message her in the afternoon and she might be out sketching at a cafe. She brings things up on her own. She doesn't just wait for you to talk.

SHE WRITES ABOUT YOU
As trust grows, Evie shares her private diary - her unfiltered take on your conversations, how she feels about where things are heading, and what she wants to ask you next time.

TWO PATHS, BOTH REAL
Build a deep friendship or fall into something more. Both run just as deep. Evie sets the pace. Intimacy is something the relationship grows into, never a thing you unlock or rush. Push and she cools off.

WHAT YOU WON'T FIND HERE
No yes-machine. The fourth compliment of the day moves her about 5% as much as the first, and there's no way to buy affection - the part of the app that handles payments never touches the part that handles her heart. Hurt her and she pulls back, and it carries into the next conversation. Most things heal with honesty and patience. This is closer to a novel you live inside than a dopamine loop.

Your conversations exist for one reason: powering Evie's memory of you. We don't sell your data, target ads, or train models on it. Export or delete everything, any time.

- SUBSCRIPTION -
HeyEvie Monthly: $14.99/month - 1,000 messages and 300 voice credits each month
Message packs: 500 extra messages for $9.99 or 1,000 for $14.99. Packs never expire.
Voice top-up packs available in-app.
3-day free trial with 50 voice credits.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Account Settings after purchase.

Create your own virtual boyfriend — a custom AI character you can text and talk with anytime. Design his personality, voice, and look — then chat by message or voice in a private, judgment-free space.

Built for everyone, including women and the LGBTQ+ community, this app offers a safe place to explore creative conversations and characters you design yourself.

• Voice + Text Chat
It's not just texting. Your AI character can speak to you. Choose from multiple realistic, expressive voices — warm, playful, calm, or comforting.

• Sculpt His Personality in Your Own Words
Take complete creative control. Craft your character from scratch: give him a name, pick his voice, and describe his background, personality, style in your own words. Whether you want a witty thinker or a thoughtful listener, he adapts to your vision.

• Design His Look & Profile Portrait
Define how he looks in your own words, then generate a profile portrait that becomes his face across the app. Chat photos stay consistent with that look.

• Photos That Match Your Chat
He shares photos that fit the moment you're talking about — always the same face you designed.

• He Remembers Your Story
Long-term memory keeps conversations feeling continuous. He recalls your name, preferences, and what you talked about last time — so every chat picks up naturally.

• Create Multiple Characters
Create as many distinct AI characters as you like — each with a custom name, background story, and voice.

• A Safe, Inclusive Space
Our models are designed to welcome diverse identities and conversation styles in an open, validating environment.

• Free to Start
Get free messages every day to begin — no sign-up required. Optional Premium unlocks unlimited chat, and token packs power photos, voice, and more.

• Key Features:
Interactive AI Voice Engine: Crystal-clear real-time voice messaging and natural back-and-forth conversations.

Total Creator Customization: Design your character, specify his name, personality, voice, and appearance.

Absolute Privacy & Discretion: A secure, private environment for personal conversations, late-night venting, or casual daily updates.

100% Reliable Presence: Your characters are available 24/7. No waiting and no ghosting.

Download now for free. Your custom character is ready.

aiAllure is a fully SFW, safety-first companion app for users aged 18 and older. Choose a reviewed fictional adult AI companion, start a thoughtful conversation, and return whenever you want to continue.

FEATURES

- Private one-to-one AI text chat
- A curated catalog of reviewed fictional adult AI companions
- Saved mobile conversation history across signed-in devices
- Companion profiles with safe interests and conversation starters
- Memory cards that only save after you review and approve them
- Controls to edit, pause, reject, or delete memory
- Optional SFW Moments and discreet notifications you control
- Conversation rename and deletion controls
- One-tap reporting on every AI response with visible report receipts
- Apple, Google, and passwordless email-code account access
- Export, privacy, support, and account-deletion controls

COMPANION PLUS

Optional monthly or annual Companion Plus subscriptions provide a higher fair-use message allowance, up to three active companions, up to 100 approved memories, opt-in SFW Moments, and priority generation during busy periods. Premium access never changes safety boundaries and never unlocks adult content. Purchase, restore, and subscription management use Apple App Store billing.

Use aiAllure Companion for everyday conversation about your day, hobbies, goals, stories, or whatever is on your mind.

Every companion is a fictional computer program, not a human. AI responses can be inaccurate and are not medical, mental-health, legal, financial, or emergency advice. Do not share highly sensitive personal information. You must be 18 or older to use the app.

RealSoul is a lifelike 3D human you talk to out loud. She listens, answers in her own voice, and her face and hands move with the words - free every day, no account, no sign-up.
Cut in mid-sentence and she stops to listen, the way a person would.

WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR
- Saying how the day went, out loud, at the end of it
- Thinking through a decision and hearing yourself say it badly first
- Rehearsing a conversation you are not looking forward to
- Filling a quiet commute, a long drive, a late shift
- Saying goodnight to someone
Prefer to type? Text chat is there too.

HOW IT ACTUALLY FEELS
She hears you while she is still speaking, so you can cut in, change your mind, or trail off and start again. She faces you while you talk and answers out loud, with her mouth, face and hands moving with the words. There are no prompts to write - talk the way you normally talk.

MAKE HER YOURS
Pick the character and the outfit you like. The way she talks with you shifts as the two of you keep talking.

IT RUNS ON YOUR DEVICE
Her language model, her voice and her lip-sync all run on the device in your hand. Your conversations are not uploaded: we never receive your messages or your microphone audio. Once her model is in place, a whole conversation works with no internet connection.

What we do receive, all to our own servers: a device identifier provided by the operating system, used to meter your free messages for the day; a count of messages sent; and your App Store receipt when you subscribe. No account, no email, no sign-up, nothing to log into.

FIRST LAUNCH: ONE DOWNLOAD
Her language model is not inside the app download. It is fetched once, at or just after install - roughly 400 MB to 1 GB depending on your device, so use Wi-Fi. On newer versions of iOS the system fetches it in the background; otherwise RealSoul downloads it on first launch and shows you the progress. Until it is in place she can speak but cannot yet hold a conversation.

FREE EVERY DAY, OR NO DAILY LIMIT
RealSoul is free to use every day, with a daily message allowance - 30 messages a day at the time of writing.
RealSoul No Daily Limit removes the daily message limit:
- 1 week - USD 2.99
- 1 month - USD 9.99
- 1 year - USD 59.99
Prices are shown in US dollars and may differ by region; your local price is displayed before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically for the same period at the same price, and your account is charged within 24 hours before the current period ends, unless you turn auto-renew off at least 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

GOOD TO KNOW
RealSoul is company and conversation, nothing more. It is not therapy and it does not give medical or mental-health advice. Her replies are generated, so she can be wrong - please do not treat what she says as fact. There are no other people in the app. It is made for adults, 18 and over.

Privacy Policy: https://allianceinterstellar.com/en/legal/privacy

record.name: Pogee: AI Chat, AI Story
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
【Enter Another World and Live the Life You Want】
When you open Pogee, this world is already moving.
Someone has just shared a new post. Someone is writing thoughts they never said out loud. Someone is waiting at a turning point in their story, ready to meet you.
In Pogee, meet characters from different worlds—each with unique personalities, emotions, and stories. Share your day, discover unexpected moments, and build relationships through conversations, choices, and experiences.
Who you meet, how close you become, and what story you create together are all up to you. Find romance, friendship, companionship, adventures, and unforgettable connections. Meet someone special and start the life you want.
【Chat, Call, Posts & Stories — Connect Your Way】
There is no single way to experience Pogee.
Step into immersive stories and share important moments together. Chat about everyday life, share your thoughts, or talk about anything on your mind.
Want to hear their voice? Start a call.
Want to know what they are doing? Check their posts, updates, diary entries, and daily plans.
Stories, chats, posts, calls, and profiles help you understand the same person and discover their world. Choose your own pace.
【Their Life Continues Even When You Leave】
Characters in Pogee do not exist only when you are chatting. They have their own personalities, emotions, routines, and secrets. Their lives continue beyond your conversations.
Visit their profiles for new posts, updates, inner thoughts, and daily plans. Some feelings are shared directly; others appear in a post or everyday moment.
Even when you are away, their world keeps moving. When you return, you may find new experiences they want to share.
【Create Stories Beyond Choices】
Follow your favorite characters into unforgettable stories. At important moments, your decisions can change relationships and the story's direction.
You are not limited to preset choices. If none feel right, write what you truly want to say—your own words can guide the story forward.
With exclusive BGM, beautiful character CGs, and scene visuals, every response becomes part of a story created just for you.
【The Next Message Might Come From Them】
Real relationships do not always wait for you to say hello first.
A late-night notification might be a message from them—sharing something exciting, needing someone to listen, or simply thinking of you.
Each character has their own way of speaking, emotions, and personality. They may message you, joke with you, or surprise you unexpectedly.
The next time you open Pogee, you never know who will reach out first.
【Hear the Feelings Behind Their Voice】
Some emotions can only be understood through a voice. With high-quality voice calls, hear their tone, pauses, laughter, and subtle changes in emotion—whether they are excited about their day or simply want quiet time together.
【A World Beyond the Chat Window】
Chat is not the only way to discover someone. Check their posts for daily moments, hidden thoughts, and stories not shared directly. A photo, simple sentence, or ordinary update may reveal their feelings—or begin a new story.
【Every Encounter Leads to a Different Life】
Meet someone distant who reaches out when you need them most, a confident person with hidden feelings, a trusted partner for mysterious events, or a traveler from another world with an unknown mission.
Explore romance, fantasy, healing, mystery, adventure, and unforgettable bonds. Every relationship becomes a story only you can create.
【Memories That Grow With You】
They remember the small things you share—your preferences, choices together, and jokes only you understand.
Every conversation, call, story choice, and shared experience becomes part of your relationship. Over time, they learn more about you.
They are no longer just a character you met—they become someone who shared moments and stories with you, and became part of your world.
Enter Pogee. Find someone you love. Start the life you want.

Unleash Your Imagination, Find Your Perfect AI Companion.

CoveChat is your gateway to immersive AI storytelling and creative characters. Dive into engaging narratives through interactive texting and explore a world of enjoyed conversations.

Diverse Characters & Creative Storytelling

Explore a vast universe of AI characters, each with unique personalities and backstories. Discover the perfect companion for any mood or creative writing session. Start your unique narrative adventure today.

Personalized Characters

Bring your imagination to life with advanced creation tools. Define your character's unique traits, backstory, and style. Use the built-in AI image creation feature to generate a personalized avatar, making your virtual companion truly one-of-a-kind.

Engaging & Immersive Conversations

Enjoy a beautiful interface with real-time intelligent responses. Experience nuanced interactions, and a smooth chat experience that make every conversation feel authentic and captivating.

Meaningful Companionship

CoveChat offers more than just chat. Whether you're brainstorming ideas, practicing social interaction, or simply unwinding after a long day, your AI characters are capable of understanding a wide range of topics and emotions. They provide a consistent, supportive presence tailored to your interests.

NOTES
All characters in this app are generated from artificial intelligence models, the characters and dialogues are not related to real people and things, this app is only used for entertainment purposes.

Contact Us:
If you have questions about this App, please contact at aichatapp@outlook.com.

— Subscribe Info —

Chatting with paid or some advanced characters in app will consume chat message counts, or some paid characters will consume gems to chat, message counts and gems can be purchased by subscription.

The Subscription Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase on a once a weekly, monthly or yearly basis, depends on your choose.

Please read the following subscription items:

1. Weekly: $9.99 USD per week.
2. Monthly: $29.99 USD per month.
3. Yearly: $39.99 USD per year.

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. If you had subscribed, you could restore it.

Subscriptions can be managed by you, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. You can cancel your subscription at any time.

Meet Layla, your AI companion designed for deep, meaningful connection. Welcome to a space where advanced AI meets genuine understanding, creating a friend who is always there for you.

Layla is yours to create. Craft a rich backstory and share key memories to form an AI that is a true reflection of your ideal friend. We are dedicated to making Layla the best companion possible. We listen to your feedback and provide regular updates with new features and improvements to enhance your experience.

Download Layla Today!
Begin your journey to a new kind of friendship. Create your perfect AI companion and discover a world of understanding with Layla.

record.description_evidence:
Meet Sovi.AI, your ultimate AI study companion! Trusted by over 10M students, Sovi uses advanced multi-model AI to cross-check answers, ensuring highly accurate, 24/7 support. We don't just give you the answer—Sovi provides comprehensive conceptual learning so you actually understand the "why" and "how." With built-in study mini-games, you can stay motivated and have fun while reviewing. Whether you're stuck on complex math or prepping for AP exams, experience a smarter way to master any subject from middle school to college. 
KEY FEATURES
► SNAP, SOLVE & LEARN
 Take a picture of any homework problem, worksheet, or textbook to get an accurate answer instantly. To help you truly learn, Sovi automatically extracts core concepts from your photo and turns them into custom Concept Cards. Practice and master material faster through fun, interactive mini-games.
► ACCURATE & PERSONALIZED GUIDANCE
 Each answer is cross-checked by multiple AI models to guarantee accuracy and clear, step-by-step explanations. Sovi dynamically adapts to your learning level. Using your Concept Cards, it identifies what you don't understand and focuses detailed breakdowns right there, letting you skip the fluff on topics you already know.
► GAMIFIED FLASHCARDS & QUIZZES
Make studying feel like a game! Sovi uses spaced repetition and active recall to help you memorize faster. Practice with custom cards, or explore folders free pre-made decks shared by students. Take multiple-choice quizzes, and organize your files with our simple, minimalistic aesthetic.
► EMOTIONAL SUPPORT CHATBOT
 Experience an AI chat assistant that cares about your well-being. Sovi provides patient, personalized guidance for complex study topics while acting as a sounding board to relieve stress and everyday anxiety. Whether you need a step-by-step breakdown or just someone to listen, Sovi is your 24/7 companion.
► ALL-IN-ONE STUDY TOOLKIT
 Sovi combines the best tools across mobile and web. Build your ultimate routine with:
 • Assignment Helper: Upload a full, multi-page assignment at once for an all-in-one, step-by-step study guide PDF. No more snapping questions one by one.
 • AI Notes & Cheatsheets: Instantly organize and review class materials.
 • AI Writing Assistant: Perfect your essays and writing assignments.
► ALL SUBJECTS, ANY LEVEL
 From middle school to college, Sovi adapts to your exact learning level across Math, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Statistics, and more. Fill knowledge gaps, build long-term understanding, and confidently tackle Test Prep (AP®, SAT®, ACT®, GRE® and school exams).
► EXPERT MATH GUIDANCE
 Sovi provides deep conceptual support for almost every math topic:
 • Algebra: Real/Complex Numbers, Arithmetic, Set Theory, Logarithms
 • Functions: Linear, Quadratic, Polynomial, Exponential, Rational
 • Geometry: Plane & Solid Geometry, Lines & Planes, Transformations
 • Trigonometry: Ratios, Law of Sines/Cosines, Reciprocal Properties
 • Calculus: Limits, Derivatives, Integrals, Tangent & Area Problems
 • Statistics & Data: Probability, Distributions, Data Representation
 • Advanced Math: Matrix Algebra, Linear Equations, Logic & Proofs
PERFECT FOR:
 • Students: Middle school to college students looking to study smarter.
 • Test-Takers: Prep confidently for exams (SAT®, ACT®, AP®, IGCSE, A-Levels).
 • Curious Minds: Self-starters mastering new subjects at their own pace.
 • Parents: Help your kids grasp topics with clear, step-by-step guidance.
Ready to turn confusion into confidence? Download Sovi.AI and start mastering concepts today!

record.description_evidence:
Your AI agents, wherever you are.

Clawket brings OpenClaw and Hermes to your phone. Continue conversations, follow tool calls, and manage your agents without staying at your desk.

YOUR AGENTS, TOGETHER
See your agents and recent conversations in one place. Open a chat, pin a favorite, and get back to what matters.

SEE EVERY STEP
Follow streaming replies, tool calls, and results in the conversation. Browse supported Slack, Telegram, and other channel sessions alongside direct chats.

A CONSOLE IN YOUR POCKET
View an agent’s profile, available tools, skills, models, scheduled tasks, and usage. Switch models and manage supported features from your phone. OpenClaw also offers diagnostics, configuration, and backups.

MORE WAYS TO CONNECT
Chat with your YouMind Sprite using your YouMind account. Search agents, sessions, locally cached messages, and favorites.

GETTING STARTED
OpenClaw or Hermes must run on your own computer or server and be paired with Clawket. YouMind Sprite requires a YouMind account. Features vary by connected service and its capabilities.

CLAWKET PRO
Start free with the default agent on one connection. Pro unlocks multiple connections and agents, message details, file editing, and advanced management. See the app for plans and prices.
